Tool.Name: editor_info
Tool.Description: Editor endpoint readiness and process kind.

Tool.Name: entity_create
Tool.Description: Create in the focused prefab through its public API. Optional parent, Vector3 position and name.

Tool.Name: entity_delete
Tool.Description: Delete entities AND all descendants in their owning instance; never the level container.

Tool.Name: entity_set_parent
Tool.Description: Reparent through EditorEntityAPIBus, preserving prefab bookkeeping. Cycles are refused.

Tool.Name: transform_set
Tool.Description: Set a tagged Transform (translation, xyzw rotation, uniform scale) in explicit local/world space with native undo.

Tool.Name: component_add
Tool.Description: Add component type UUIDs through native dependency/conflict handling, with undo.

Tool.Name: component_remove
Tool.Description: Remove component instance pairs through the native composition API, with undo.

Tool.Name: component_set
Tool.Description: Set a native property-tree value with native notifications, dirty tracking and undo.

Tool.Name: level_create
Tool.Description: Create project folder/name/name.prefab through the native new-level path, without dialogs. Disk creation is not undoable. Empty template creates a native empty level.

Tool.Name: level_open
Tool.Description: Open a level without unattended save prompts; unsaved changes default to reject.

Tool.Name: level_save
Tool.Description: Save the current level; report dirty prefab templates separately. Saving files is not undoable.

Tool.Name: prefab_create
Tool.Description: Create a nested prefab in memory from entities, with native undo; save explicitly with prefab_save.

Tool.Name: prefab_save
Tool.Description: Explicitly save the requested prefab template using its native public API; no disk rollback.

Tool.Name: asset_import
Tool.Description: Copy an absolute source into a new project asset-safe destination, wait for AP jobs and catalog products, return IDs or job errors. Never overwrites; copied files remain on failure/cancellation. Disk copying is not undoable.

Tool.Name: editor_play
Tool.Description: Request play in editor and wait for the actual mode transition.

Tool.Name: editor_stop
Tool.Description: Stop play and wait for the editor mode transition.

Tool.Name: editor_state
Tool.Description: Read native document path/dirty/readiness, play mode, prefab focus/dirty paths and pending propagation.

Tool.Name: editor_undo
Tool.Description: Undo through the editor's existing undo stack, then wait for prefab propagation.

Tool.Name: editor_redo
Tool.Description: Redo through the editor's existing undo stack, then wait for prefab propagation.

Tool.Name: python_execute
Tool.Description: Run Python in the editor's interpreter on the main thread, in a fresh namespace. Returns stdout, stderr and the traceback of an uncaught exception. Listed only when the PythonExecute setting enables it.

Param.Name: timeout_ms
Param.Description: Stops the code at its next Python line after this long; native calls are not interrupted. Defaults to the connection deadline.

Tool.Name: screenshot
Tool.Description: Capture the editor viewport, a dock panel or the whole main window as a PNG image.

Param.Name: panel
Param.Description: View pane name for target=panel, e.g. Entity Inspector; an unknown name returns the available names.

Param.Name: position
Param.Description: Viewport camera position, given together with look_at.

Param.Name: look_at
Param.Description: Point the viewport camera looks at, given together with position.
